attacks.name: object_lock_downgrade
attacks.note: The static defence is proven instead by policy-as-code over the OpenTofu plan JSON (`infra/policy/custody/object_lock.rego`, `scripts/custody/check_evidence_plan.py`): the bucket must declare `object_lock_enabled` AT CREATION and versioning, and no principal in the write account may hold `s3:DeleteObject*`, `s3:PutObjectRetention`, `s3:PutObjectLegalHold` or `s3:BypassGovernanceRetention`. GT-18 is a one-shot: Object Lock cannot be retrofitted, so it must be right the first time.
